<h2 class="wp-block-heading">About Beyond / Hello Illinois</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Beyond / Hello has 5 dispensaries in the state of Illinois, proudly serving both medical cannabis patients and adult-use recreational customers. Illinois legalized adult-use cannabis on January 1, 2020 through the Cannabis Regulation and Tax Act. Adults 21 and older can purchase recreational cannabis, and medical patients enrolled in the Illinois Medical Cannabis Pilot Program have access to additional benefits.</p><p>Beyond / Hello Illinois dispensaries accept debit cards and cash. ATMs are available on-site at all locations.</p>



<p class="has-small-font-size wp-block-paragraph">* Illinois residents 21+ may purchase adult-use cannabis. Medical patients must hold a valid Illinois medical cannabis card.</p>
</div>

<script>
(function () {

  function isSpecialsPage() {
    return window.location.pathname.includes('/specials');
  }

  function injectJaneStyles() {
    if (!isSpecialsPage()) return;

    const host = document.querySelector('#shadow-host');
    if (!host || !host.shadowRoot) return false;

    const root = host.shadowRoot;

    let style = root.querySelector('#jane-specials-image-style');
    if (!style) {
      style = document.createElement('style');
      style.id = 'jane-specials-image-style';
      root.appendChild(style);
    }

    style.textContent = `
      #specials-grid div[style*="--image-height"] {
        aspect-ratio: 335 / 165 !important;
        height: auto !important;
        --image-height: auto !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
      }

      #specials-grid div[style*="--image-height"] img {
        width: 100% !important;
        height: 100% !important;
        object-fit: cover !important;
        display: block !important;
      }
    `;

    return true;
  }

  const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
    injectJaneStyles();
  });

  observer.observe(document.body, {
    childList: true,
    subtree: true
  });

  injectJaneStyles();
  window.addEventListener('load', injectJaneStyles);
  setTimeout(injectJaneStyles, 1000);
  setTimeout(injectJaneStyles, 2500);

})();
</script>
